rv.q: THE 39 STEPS is fast, goofy, a little too hyper, clever, and unapologetically theatrical—and mines a helluva lot of laughs from it.
The show might profit from some trims — or maybe in an intermission-free, 95-minute format? — but there’s energetic talent to burn on display and enough fun for a nondemanding outing.
Under Hunter Foster’s direction, the production is pure perfection.

cn.t: Critics agree this Hitchcock comedy reimagining is a wildly funny triumph. Four actors tackling 100+ characters earns high praise for its relentless physical comedy and outrageous energy.
